uncertainties: Exact thickness of the base and panel is inferred from the stroke width in the right view relative to the overall scale.
Exact alignment of the cutouts is based on the visual centering in the front view.
generation_notes: The object is modeled as a single solid. The L-profile is defined by the right view (YZ plane). The front view (XZ plane) defines the width and the positions of the four rectangular cutouts. The cutouts are treated as subtractive features through the panel wall.

user_intent.description: L-shaped bookend: a flat base and an upright panel. The panel has four through openings cut all the way through its wall.

multi_view_contract: All source views constrain one shared physical object; never instantiate views as separate geometry.
cutout_policy: Closed internal profiles are subtractive through-cutouts unless explicitly classified otherwise.
